documents.name: harbour-interview
documents.text:
Interview at the harbour office, recorded for the port archive.

HARBOUR MASTER  00:00:04
The ferry has run late every Tuesday this spring.

Interviewer (00:00:11)
Why the ferry and not the mail boat?

[00:00:15] HARBOUR MASTER:
The tide tables were printed for a deeper channel.
We sail by tables nobody trusts.

1:02:07
The recording ends with the foghorn.
